name: Roshan Perera
bio: Roshan founded Evox Technology in 2015 with a vision to deliver world-class software solutions. With over 15 years of experience in enterprise architecture, he leads the company's strategic direction and innovation initiatives.

name: Nimal Fernando
bio: Nimal oversees all technology decisions at Evox. He brings deep expertise in cloud architecture, microservices, and AI-driven systems, having previously led engineering teams at leading tech companies.

name: Samanthi Jayawardena
bio: Samanthi manages day-to-day operations and client relations. Her background in project management and process optimization ensures every Evox project is delivered on time and to the highest standard.

name: Tharindu Wickramasinghe
bio: Tharindu leads the engineering division with a focus on scalable, secure, and maintainable systems. He is passionate about developer experience and building high-performance teams.
